title: SC declines interim stay on Speaker’s decision to approve Uddhav Sena MPs’ ‘merger’ with Shinde faction
description: Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Arvind Sawant, who filed the petition, argued that the purported merger is ‘unconstitutional’ and ‘perverse’; the Bench, however, declined to give any such assurance and posted the matter for hearing after two weeks
